pension.title: Pension

pension.name: Name
pension.pasteHint: One holding per line: name and value (tab, semicolon or two spaces between). Optional third column = projected monthly payout.
pension.futureHint: Coming soon: withdrawal planning — model when and how much to draw down in retirement.
pension.netWorthHint: Net worth = investments + pension capital + home equity. Pension is capital, not monthly cash flow, so it is not part of the budget's net result.
pension.propertyHint: Your equity = (market value − the loan on it) × your share. Only valued properties count toward net worth.
pension.loansHint: Assign each loan to the property it's secured on so it offsets that property's value.

help.title: Help & Guide
help.subtitle: How FinKoll works, and how to run your budget each month.

quickstart.title: Your monthly budget in 6 steps
quickstart.intro: Set up a reusable template once, then apply it to any month — including future ones — with a single click.

steps.title: Set up your categories
steps.desc: Add the income, expense and savings categories you use, and give each a colour. The colour flows through every chart and table.

steps.title: Build your monthly template
steps.desc: Add a recurring template for everything that repeats — salary, rent, subscriptions, savings. Set the amount, category and the month it starts from. This is your reusable budget.

steps.title: Apply the template to a month
steps.desc: Open Monthly, pick the month, and click ‘Apply Recurring’. FinKoll fills the month with transactions from your templates in one click.

steps.title: Track and adjust
steps.desc: Edit amounts, split a transaction into items, add comments, or add one-off transactions. The cards show income, expenses, savings and net result live.

steps.title: Clear and redo a month
steps.desc: Need a fresh start? Click ‘Clear Month’ to remove that month’s transactions, then apply the template again.

steps.title: Plan future months
steps.desc: Move the selector forward and apply your template to any future month. To shift every template’s start month at once, use ‘Apply to all’ in Settings.

dataHealth.title: Data Health
dataHealth.subtitle: Problems that quietly distort your analysis. Nothing here is changed automatically — review and fix what matters.
dataHealth.allClear: No data-quality issues found. Nice and tidy.
dataHealth.negDesc: Expense or savings entries stored as a negative — usually a refund. They quietly cancel out a category total.
dataHealth.ungroupedDesc: These categories don't roll up into any group, so they're missing from the group breakdowns.
dataHealth.dupDesc: Two or more active categories share a name, which splits what should be one total. Merge them.
dataHealth.splitTitle: Split totals that don't add up
dataHealth.splitDesc: The split lines don't sum to the transaction amount — the split is wrong somewhere.
dataHealth.housingDesc: These are in a housing category but aren't assigned to a property, so they miss the housing totals.
dataHealth.unusedDesc: Active categories with no transactions. Harmless, but they clutter the pickers — consider hiding them.
